scope: All pre-existing repository image/video files under docs and .github, and Markdown/HTML media references in repository Markdown documents. External PR/Issue references are not enumerated.
ocrMethod: macOS Vision accurate text recognition, zh-Hans and en-US, language correction disabled; case/whitespace-normalized old Chinese noun and memory body/bodies detection. SVG sources read as text; historical motion files retained without a new frame-level audit. OCR results support manual inspection.
